data.long_description:
Provident Real estate is delighted to present this exceptional 6-bedroom Contemporary villa for rent in District One Villas, one of the most prestigious and exclusive residential communities in Mohammed Bin Rashid City.

This stunning villa offers expansive living spaces, high-end finishes, and a serene waterfront lifestyle, ideal for families seeking privacy, comfort, and luxury in the heart of Dubai.

• 6 Bedrooms 
• 9 Bathrooms
. Maids Room
. Driver Room
• Private Elevator
• Fully Equipped Kitchen
• Private Swimming Pool
• Covered Parking Spaces

Community Features & Amenities:

• Direct Access to Crystal Lagoon
• Gated & Secure Community
• Private Landscaped Surroundings
• Cycling & Jogging Tracks
• Premium Clubhouse Facilities
• Waterfront Walkways
• Concierge Services
• Smart Home Technology
• Sports Courts
• Luxury Retail & Dining Nearby

About the Community:

District One Villas offers a refined lifestyle defined by elegance, privacy, and breathtaking surroundings. Known for its crystal-clear lagoon, lush green landscapes, and contemporary architecture, the community delivers a perfect balance of tranquility and connectivity.

Strategically located within Mohammed Bin Rashid City, residents enjoy quick access to Downtown Dubai, major highways, and key lifestyle destinations.
